items.title: Comparison of cohomology with support in the derived category of modules with its abelian-sheaf version
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the canonical maps RGamma_Z(X, K) -> RGamma_Z(X, K_ab) and R-H_Z(K) -> R-H_Z(K_ab), where K_ab is the image of K in the derived category of abelian sheaves, are isomorphisms. The proof builds the first map from the functoriality of Gamma_Z on abelian sheaves and shows that it fits with the canonical maps of the abelian-comparison lemma into a morphism of distinguished triangles coming from the sections-with-support triangle; since two of the three arrows are known isomorphisms, the five lemma in the derived category gives the third (proof lines 8724-8757). The sheaf-level statement is then deduced in the same manner. H2: the triangle comparison and the conclusion by the five lemma are the substance.
